home.intro: <highlight>Full-Stack Developer</highlight> building fast, bilingual (Arabic/English) web applications with React & Next.js — delivered end to end, from polished interfaces to APIs, databases, and deployment. Today I lead the digital systems of an international medical complex in Jeddah: ZATCA-compliant e-invoicing, WhatsApp patient communication, and n8n automations that save the team hours every single day.
